enum Expr[A]:
  case Const(value: Int) extends Expr[Int]
  case BoolConst(value: Boolean) extends Expr[Boolean]
  case Add(lhs: Expr[Int], rhs: Expr[Int]) extends Expr[Int]
  case IfThen(cond: Expr[Boolean], t: Expr[A], f: Expr[A]) extends Expr[A]

def eval[A](expr: Expr[A]): A = expr match
  case Expr.Const(v)        => v
  case Expr.BoolConst(v)    => v
  case Expr.Add(l, r)       => eval(l) + eval(r)
  case Expr.IfThen(c, t, f) => if eval(c) then eval(t) else eval(f)
